This device has 2x USB 2.0 and 2x SATA II ports. *"DDM25L1 V1.1" and "08-04DDM2511" are silkscreened on the board. {{See also|List of NAS Devices|Synology DiskStation Devices}} ===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Marvell]] 88F6707 (88F6-BM12) @1.2GHz (''Armada 370'') *Memory: 256MB (DDR3L) SDRAM ([[Samsung]] K4B2G1646E) *Storage: 8MB (SPI NOR) Flash, 2x SATA II slots *Network: 1x Gigabit Ethernet, 2x USB 2.0 ports *Power: 12V, 6A via DIN ==Links of Interest== ===Reviews=== *[https://www.insidegadgets.com/2016/12/18/inside-the-synology-ds214se-dual-bay-nas/ ''Synology DiskStation DS214se'' on '''InsideGadgets'''] *[https://www.storagereview.com/review/synology-diskstation-ds214-review ''Synology DiskStation DS214+'' on '''StorageReview'''] ==Pictures==
